_comment: Copy this file to devbox.json (gitignored) and fill in your device. devbox.json is NOT committed.
_ssh_note: Leave ssh_key null to use the ssh default (~/.ssh/id_* or ssh-agent). Set it to override. ssh_password is only used if set (via sshpass -e); key auth is strongly preferred since the MCP process can't prompt for a passphrase.
_guard_note: When true, devbox_shell blocks a small catastrophic set (reboot/dd-to-device/mkfs/fork-bomb/rm -rf /). All normal dev commands are unrestricted. Set false only if you understand the risk.
